title: Enforce multi-agent conflict detection and safe handoff
goal: Detect overlapping mutable scopes and ownership conflicts between active agents, then produce a deterministic safe handoff or stop condition.
inputs: active work graph and strict manifests
outputs: scope-overlap detector over active lease manifest allowed_paths
exact-head safe handoff artifact and release/reacquire protocol
explicit read-only lease mode for non-mutating concurrent agents
invariants: Git and CI reality outrank cached coordination state
coordination metadata never authorizes product-runtime behavior
a stale agent cannot silently overwrite a valid newer claim
recovery avoids repeating expensive verified work when evidence is still valid
security_properties: lease and journal inputs are untrusted data and strictly validated
agent identity is opaque coordination metadata, not an authentication credential
recovery never force-pushes or rewrites Git history
acceptance_tests: unit tests reject overlapping mutating scopes
unit tests allow overlap only when one lease is explicitly read-only
unit tests prove handoff identity/digest and post-release reacquisition requirement

performance_budget.rationale: coordination must reduce recovery/context cost rather than dominate ordinary development
metrics: coordination checks remain metadata-scale and PR-suitable

rollback.strategy: revert the E7 unit while retaining verified E0-E6 controls

definition_of_done: overlapping allowed paths with concurrent active leases fail closed unless explicitly non-mutating
handoff references exact work unit and Git head
released claims cannot mutate without reacquisition
no hidden coordinator service is required
